name: signalk-pypilot-newui
description: Signal K friendly UI for the pypilot autopilot, with first-class Signal K paths and Simple Switches so any downstream Signal K client can drive or monitor the pilot. Touch-first mobile visor + full pypilot data (servo, gains, calibration, tack, warnings). Coexists with pypilot-autopilot-provider.

screenshots.title: Control - compass rose with heading + precision gauge (green/orange/red), AWA/TWA wind arrows, hull-fixed sailing wedges, configurable bottom chip (SOG/depth/polar%/custom) and an AIS collision target painted as a tinted top-view hull

Chartplotter integrated - double-tap the rose to open Freeboard-SK embedded inside the rose box; every AIS target, route and your position with the autopilot buttons still reachable. Needs a Signal K chart provider (e.g. @signalk/charts-plugin)
Logbook - auto-recorded trip detail with OpenSeaMap trace, speed-coloured track, gust / peak-SOG / low-voltage / tack markers and a SOG vs AWS chart

Tune - PID gain sliders per pilot/profile with plain-language help ('act now reflex', 'closes sustained drift'), PROFILE badge, locked by default with +/-10 and +/-1 fine-tune buttons and a reset-to-baseline icon
Chart - history window with hover-freeze showing HDG cmd, HDG act, AWA, SOG and Servo A at any point of the timeline
Tack history - persistent per-tack log with best retention and fastest recovery highlighted, filterable by day range
